cursor-plan.json.selection: Highest throughput eligible per arm/writer count; same-run p99, CPU and context switches. Flag p99>10ms or mean fdatasync>1ms; retain all raw samples.

cursor-plan.json.context: getrusage RUSAGE_SELF deltas only around timed write interval; identical optional probe in both binaries; no hot-path attribution or perf sampling.

confirmation-plan.json.purpose: Final focused confirmation with unchanged binaries: batch1/batch8 near-negative guard samples and point16 missing eligible arms. Two reversed rounds, one fixed 45s cooldown. No source changes, tuning, or additional automatic cohorts after this.

cpu-plan.json.purpose: Publication CPU diagnostic only: memtable/MVCC scopes, sample rate 64; no global allocator wrapper, stack sampling or detailed WAL diagnostics. Do not treat as retention qualification.
cpu-plan.json.selection: Preserve and flag all p99>10ms or mean fdatasync>1ms runs. Compare complete same-run metrics. Inclusive phase estimates, scaled separately per thread; sampling overhead retained in both arms.

roles-plan.json.stage: Role separation: one readiness subscriber; followers subscribe only to durable publication/handoff. Same batch64 8/16 screen; solo/point guards conditional on passing. No policy or digest changes.
roles-plan.json.context: getrusage RUSAGE_SELF deltas only around timed write interval; identical optional probe in both binaries; no hot-path attribution or perf sampling.
